title: THE CELARIS DIRECTIVE
message:
DIRECTIVE OVERVIEW
DOCUMENT CLASSIFICATION: CELARIS / LEVEL II

The Celaris Directive was established to investigate the possibility of achieving controlled biological advancement through the utilization of Caro Viva-derived compounds.

Initial findings indicate that Ichor possesses properties capable of accelerating cellular regeneration, facilitating physiological adaptation, and increasing an organism's receptivity to external supernatural influences.

The directive seeks to establish a reliable method of regulating these effects.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVES
1. Identify the biological mechanisms responsible for Ichor production.
2. Establish consistent methods of extraction and refinement.
3. Determine the limitations of Ichor-induced biological adaptation.
4. Investigate the relationship between biological alteration and supernatural receptivity.
5. Develop a stable model for controlled organism enhancement.

title: SUBJECT 613: <Substance-1X0R Testing>
message:
DIRECTIVE OVERVIEW

AGE:23

OBSERVATIONS
11:07 PM: After injecting the subject with Substance 1X0R near its nape, the subject quickly convulsed and the skin near the point of injection quickly decomposed due to necrosis.
11:12 PM: The subject showed lower EMG readings on its left side, and its body is healing rapidly simmilar to how a tumor spreads.
11:15 PM: The Subject regained consciousness, its eyes a deep black. It cannot remember where it is, nor who it is. It seemed to have accelerated the symptoms of the brain cancer.
11:27 PM: The subject started rapidly growing tendril-like meat vines crawling over his right arm, and is more aggressive towards the electronics and other scientists.
11:54 PM: The subject's muscle mass grew 4x than normal, it became more hostile, it's veins bulging out a black liquid every time it screams.
01:17 AM: The subject seemed to have evolved into being able to control its flesh tendrils. 
03:24 AM: The creature escaped. No alarms were sounded. We fear it may be inside. The subject left a mixture of blood and a dark liquid in the room, small tendril structures reach out.

Findings reveal an substantial acceleration with this new liquid found within the Caro Viva.
